title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-aug-2026-jasmin-notes-draft
content:
Context / purpose:
- Prep notes for Aug roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML). Goal: align on priorities for H2/Q4 infra + model serving work and flag regressions/risks from recent experiments.

Attendees (expected):
- Priya (Product PM, Hosted API)
- Ethan (Eng lead, Serving Runtime)
- Maya (Applied ML)
- Samir (SRE/Observability)
- me (Jasmin, PM-support / note-taker)

Agenda (30-45m):
1) Quick status (5m) — 3 bullets from each area (product, eng, applied ml)
2) Model onboarding / perf targets (10m) — Maya to summarize quantization/kv-cache experiment results
3) Incidents / reliability risks (5m) — Samir: latency tail regressions after autoscaler change
4) Roadmap trade-offs (15m) — decide prioritization for: a) batching + caching sprints, b) rollout of v2 kernels, c) dedicated capacity scaling policy changes
5) Next steps & owners (5m)

Notes / data to bring:
- Latest perf dashboard: per-route token latency (console link) — ask Samir to drop key chart before meeting
- Maya: short summary of MQA vs 8-bit quant experiments + quality regression numbers on internal eval set (bench ids: INF-789, INF-790)
- Ethan: rough ETA for kernel selection rollout (canary plan + rollback steps) — pull up PR #3421
- Product: top 2 features needing lower 95p latency (customer A and B) — Priya to bring use cases

Scratch observations (from recent runs):
- KV cache hit rate improved to ~23% for chat-workload after prefix caching change, but per-token CPU overhead rose ~6% on p3.xlarge instances. Need to validate if this is noise or systematic.
- Continuous batching reduced cost by ~12% on throughput tests but increased 95p latency for short requests (<=20 tokens). Might need adaptive batching threshold (by route).
- MQA quantization produced ~1.5% quality drop on rouge/qa tasks but reduced memory footprint enabling larger batch sizes on the same GPU. Tradeoff acceptable for background tasks but not for core chat route.

Unresolved questions to raise:
- Can we gate quantized variants by route or tenant? (Priya ask Legal/security if any compliance concerns)
- Autoscaler change (release 2026-07-28) correlated with latency tail bump — is it due to slower node warm-up or config mismatch? (Ethan + SRE to investigate)
- Do we want to push canary for v2 kernels to 10% traffic or keep at 5% until further perf testing? Maya suggests 10% gives better data; SRE prefers 5% until rollback tested.

Proposed decisions (if time):
- Short-term: prioritize adaptive batching by route (eng sprint next 2 weeks) + experimental feature flag for quantized model routing for background endpoints.
- Medium-term: schedule kernel rollout canary at 10% for non-critical tenants, require explicit rollback playbook and smoke tests (owner: Ethan).
- Observability: add synthetic traffic checks for 95p latency on critical routes (owner: Samir).

Action items (owner — due):
- Maya: prepare 2-slide summary of quantization experiments + link to eval jobs (INF-789, INF-790). Due: 2026-08-04.
- Ethan: draft canary rollout plan for v2 kernels (steps, smoke tests, rollback). Post to PR #3421 and Confluence. Due: 2026-08-09.
- Samir: extract 95p latency dashboard and share permalink in #prod-observability before meeting. Due: 2026-08-03.
- Priya: write feature-priority doc for 2 customer asks that need lower latency; include business impact. Due: 2026-08-06.
- Jasmin (me): follow up on autoscaler config diff and notify infra on suspected warm-up issue; send summary email with decisions. Due: 2026-08-05.

Notes-to-self / follow-ups after meeting:
- Capture decision log in CONFLUENCE-ROADMAP-TEAM-5234 (add links to PRs and dashboards).
- Update roadmap board (Jira epic ROADMAP-2026-Q4) with new order if adaptive batching accepted.
- Schedule 30m deep-dive with Maya + Ethan next week to go over KV cache perf tradeoffs (propose 2026-08-11).

Quick links / references to paste in meeting chat:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ROADMAP/Team+Roadmap (team page)
- Jira Epic: ROADMAP-2026-Q4
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prs/3421
- Perf jobs: internal-bench/INF-789, internal-bench/INF-790

Risks / blockers to flag to execs if asked:
- If adaptive batching is delayed, expected monthly ops spend could increase ~8% due to less efficient GPU utilization on chat-heavy routes.
- Quantization rollout without per-route gating risks regression for paying customers using core chat (recommend canary + opt-in per tenant).

Tone & ask during sync: be concrete (numbers + owners). Aim to leave meeting with 3 clear commitments.

Draft meeting opener (copy-paste):
"Quick status (2m each) -> one metric + one ask. Then align on three decisions: adaptive batching sprint, quantized routing experiment, kernel rollout canary percentage. Leave with owners & dates."

Random TODOs (personal scratchpad):
- Check if we already have feature-flagging infra to route to quantized model per-tenant (ask platform-engineering).
- Ping legal on data retention for private deployments when using quantized checkpoints.
- Consider adding a small eval prompt set that reflects customer A’s top-5 cases (Maya to help curate).

End of notes.
